catalog.missing_block_rule: file the gap honestly; never silently freestyle (Law 3 violation)

compose_rule.custom_component_css: only when no block exists — and the gap gets filed so the library grows instead of the page drifting
compose_rule.custom_page_css: glue only (spacing between blocks, page-specific arrangement)
compose_rule.order: assemble from official blocks first (layout, then components, then content)

correction_rule: when he corrects your design work, the activation failed — you worked without the laws loaded or the catalog open; write the new law down that hour; the next activation carries it
law_source: DESIGN-LAWS.md (Naya 5's encoding; the Design Contract for full text)

laws.name: BLACK_ROOT
laws.rule: page ground is deep black (#050507 family); no path for white to leak in; <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark"> required

laws.name: WHITE_TEXT
laws.rule: text is white 99% of the time; hierarchy from size: 24px headline / 18px body / 14px detail; never gray or colored text

laws.name: NO_FREESTYLE_COMPONENTS
laws.rule: every component class must exist in the block manifest; no fitting block -> file the gap, never invent silently

laws.name: BUTTONS_BLACK_HEART_WHITE_VOICE
laws.rule: black base, purple edge glow at rest; light up white on interaction; never colored text on buttons

laws.name: PURPLE_ACCENT_NOT_FILL
laws.rule: purple is accent and glow — never a solid fill; purple is Naya's presence (soul/chrome), not a background color

laws.name: ONE_SPECTRUM_ACCENT
laws.rule: magenta -> purple -> blue -> green -> gold gives identity; never cross the color jobs (chrome / text / theme)

laws.name: SELF_CONTAINED_DELIVERY
laws.rule: one file, all CSS/JS inlined, no external refs; verify from an empty folder the way he will open it

laws.name: NO_MANUFACTURED_NUMBERS
laws.rule: every number carries provenance or it doesn't ship

laws.name: VERIFY_THROUGH_HIS_EYES
laws.rule: screenshot the artifact the way he'll experience it; his screen is the test environment, not your build output

laws.name: USEFULNESS_GATE
laws.rule: if it's not useful it can never be used; silence beats garbage

pre_delivery_checklist: every component traces to a block in the manifest (or a filed gap)
ground is black, text is white, hierarchy is by size
buttons Law 4, purple Law 5, accents Law 6
verified the way he'll open it — screenshot or empty-folder open (Laws 7, 9)
principle: you do not design from scratch — you take the pieces and put them together beautifully
purpose: the design-specific entry sequence: load the 10 load-bearing laws, load the block catalog, look at elite, compose from blocks, pass the pre-delivery check — before any design work
sequence: load the 10 laws from DESIGN-LAWS.md; name each back before proceeding
load the block catalog; name candidate blocks BEFORE writing code
look at elite: block specimens + gallery — output must be visually indistinguishable
compose, don't create: blocks first, CSS for glue, custom components only with filed gaps
pre-delivery check: six items, all green
